body:
## Objective
Build a keyboard-accessible form with date, time, location/timezone, and other required chart inputs.

## Sprint
Sprint 1 (target: 2026-11-06)

## Board status
Sprint Todo (to be assigned when the Project board is available)

## Dependencies
Application scaffold; calculation interface

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Required fields have accessible labels
- [ ] Invalid and missing values show actionable errors
- [ ] No birth information is logged
- [ ] Unit tests cover input validation

## Verification
Attach test output, screenshots where applicable, and a pull request referencing this issue.

## Planning note
Estimate and milestone assignment are pending. Scope may be split further during sprint planning.
title: Implement validated birth-input form
